title: The Band Reunites

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: I can't believe you got Lois back. I thought her drum playing days were long gone!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't believe you got Lois back. I thought her drum playing days were long gone!

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: And Olive! By CORA, I thought she was dead. And she's playing the theremin! I mean, who knows when she learned to do that...? Or why the fuck we want a theremin? But we have one!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And Olive! By CORA, I thought she was dead. And she's playing the theremin! I mean, who knows when she learned to do that...? Or why the fuck we want a theremin? But we have one!

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: Well, that's the great thing about names: you can change them when they don't fit you anymore.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, that's the great thing about names: you can change them when they don't fit you anymore.

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: And Danny! That guy really took our musical change of direction HARD. Such a genre purist.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And Danny! That guy really took our musical change of direction HARD. Such a genre purist.

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: We owe it all to you bud. You want to know our band name? I am 99 percent sure we will keep it for the whole night.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We owe it all to you bud. You want to know our band name? I am 99 percent sure we will keep it for the whole night.

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: Well, I gotta go. The band needs me. Damn... that feels good to say. Thanks again bud. I mean it. Wish us luck!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I gotta go. The band needs me. Damn... that feels good to say. Thanks again bud. I mean it. Wish us luck!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You shouldn't add any Oh oh ohs this time around.
